description: Collect trending symbols and public messages from Stocktwits: trend scores, sectors and watchlist counts, plus message text, sentiment, likes and cashtags per symbol. Pay per row.
readme:
# Stocktwits Scraper

Collect trending symbols and public messages from Stocktwits. Pick one of two modes: the list of trending symbols, or the messages written about symbols you choose. You pay per row delivered.

The data comes from the public [Stocktwits](https://stocktwits.com/) data feed. No account and no API key are needed.

## What you get

Every row has a `kind` field, either `symbol` or `message`, and an `id`. A row is unique by `kind` and `id`.

### Symbol rows (mode `trendingSymbols`)

One row per trending symbol, with every public symbol field the source shows:

- `id`, `url`, `symbol`, `symbolMic`, `symbolDisplay`, `title`
- `exchange`, `region`, `instrumentClass`, `sector`, `industry`, `logoUrl`, `aliases`
- `watchlistCount`: how many watchlists hold the symbol
- `trending`, `trendingScore`, `rank`, `trendRanks`: the trend position overall and within region, exchange and class
- `trendSummary` and `trendSummaryAt`: the short text the source shows on why the symbol trends
- `cusip`, `isin`, `externalId`, `tradeStatus`, `hasPricing`, `liveEvent`, `features`, `earningsId`, `earningsCta`, `shouldSeoIndex`
- `fundamentals`: the company figures the source lists, such as market cap, PE ratio, EPS, 52 week range, dividend and share counts
- `scrapedAt`

### Message rows (mode `symbolStreams`)

One row per public message:

- `id`, `url`, `body`, `createdAt`
- `authorUsername`, `authorName`, `authorId`, `authorOfficial`, `authorFollowers`: the public author details shown on the message
- `sentiment`: `Bullish`, `Bearish` or null when the poster set none
- `likes`, `reshares`, `replies`, `isReply`, `parentMessageId`, `inReplyToMessageId`, `reshareOfId`
- `cashtags`: the cashtags written in the text, for example `$AAPL`
- `symbols`: the symbols the message mentions, each with id, name, exchange, class, watchlist count and url
- `prices`: the price of each mentioned symbol when the message was posted
- `links`: shared links with title, description, image and the site they point to
- `mediaUrls`: image, chart and GIF addresses
- `sourceApp`: the app the message was posted from
- `collectedForSymbol`, `collectedForTitle`, `collectedForWatchlistCount`: the symbol stream the message was read from, with its name and watchlist count
- `scrapedAt`

A value the source does not show is null. Lists with nothing in them are empty.

## Typical uses

- Track which tickers and coins the crowd talks about today
- Measure the share of Bullish and Bearish messages for a symbol
- Feed a dashboard, a research sheet or a model with fresh messages and cashtags
- Watch sectors and watchlist counts of trending symbols over time

## Pricing

You pay per row delivered, plus a small fee for each run.

| Event | Name | Price |
|---|---|---|
| Run start (charged once, together with the first delivered row) | `actor-start` | $0.001 per run |
| One row, symbol or message | `result-row` | $0.002 per row ($2.00 per 1,000) |

A run that finds nothing is not charged. If you set a maximum cost for the run, the actor stops cleanly once the next row would go over it.

**New to Apify?** Every account gets a $5 free monthly platform credit, enough for a first test run before you pay anything.

## Input

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | choice | `trendingSymbols` | `trendingSymbols` or `symbolStreams` |
| `symbols` | list | empty | Tickers for `symbolStreams`, for example `AAPL`, `TSLA`, `BRK.B`, `BTC.X`. A comma separated text also works |
| `maxItems` | number | 100 | Maximum rows in total, up to 10,000 |

How it works:

- `trendingSymbols` returns the symbols the source lists as trending right now, usually about 30.
- `symbolStreams` reads the newest messages of each symbol, 30 per page, and goes back page by page until `maxItems` is reached or the source has no more. With several symbols it reads one page of each in turn, so a small `maxItems` still covers every symbol. A message that appears in two symbol streams is delivered once.
- If you give `symbols` and no `mode`, the actor uses `symbolStreams`.
- Number fields also accept numbers written as text, for example `"50"`.
- Started with no input, the actor returns the trending symbols.

### Example: trending symbols

```json
{
  "mode": "trendingSymbols"
}
```

### Example: messages for two symbols

```json
{
  "mode": "symbolStreams",
  "symbols": ["AAPL", "TSLA"],
  "maxItems": 100
}
```

  "id": 668488893,

## Limitations

- Each message row includes the author's public username, display name, id, official flag and follower count as shown on the public message. It has no profile pictures, bios or other profile details. `url` is null when the source shows no username.
- The actor reads what the source shows publicly. The newest messages come first, and the source decides how far back a stream goes. Very old messages may not be reachable.
- `likes` and `reshares` are counts at `scrapedAt` and change over time. A message without likes shows 0.
- `sentiment` is only set when the poster chose Bullish or Bearish. Most messages have none.
- `replies` is only given for messages that belong to a conversation.
- `url` values are built from the ids and point to the public page of the message or symbol. The actor does not open those pages.
- `fundamentals` holds the figures the source lists, as it lists them. Funds and coins often have few or none.
- `trendingSymbols` returns the current list only. Run it on a schedule to build a history.
- The source limits how often it answers. If it keeps refusing, the run stops with a status that says so, and only delivered rows are charged.

## FAQ

**Do I need a Stocktwits account?**
No. The actor reads public data.

**Why does a symbol give no rows?**
The source does not know the ticker. The run status names it. Use the ticker as written on Stocktwits, for example `BRK.B` or `BTC.X` for a coin.

**Why did I get fewer rows than `maxItems`?**
The source held fewer messages for your selection, or the maximum cost you set for the run was reached. The run status message says which.

**Why does a message show only one symbol in `collectedForSymbol`?**
A message that appears in the streams of two symbols is delivered once, under the first symbol you listed. The `symbols` field still lists every symbol the message mentions.

**Can I get the author of a message?**
Yes. Each message row includes the author's public username, display name, id, official flag and follower count as shown on the public message. It has no profile pictures, bios or other profile details.

## Use with AI agents (MCP)

Connect this actor to any MCP-compatible AI client, such as Claude Desktop, Cursor, VS Code, LangChain or LlamaIndex.

**MCP server URL:**

```
https://mcp.apify.com?tools=nanodata/stocktwits-scraper
```

**Example prompt once connected:**

> "Use `stocktwits-scraper` to list the 20 trending symbols on Stocktwits with their trending score. Return results as a table."

Found a problem or need a field added? Open an issue on the [Issues tab](https://apify.com/nanodata/stocktwits-scraper/issues). We usually reply within one business day. You can also email contact@nanoscrape.com.
